ja: コミックボンボンで好評連載中の「SD頑駄無　武者○伝3」に登場する破牙丸の仲間になる武者頑無史上初の怪獣使い武者「円従烏賊と火威獣丸(マルジュウイカとカイジュウマル)」のBB戦士のプラモデル。トノ(オコチャマ形態)と円従烏賊の2体入りです。融合合体させると火威獣丸武者形態への変身を再現できます。トマホーク、手斧、刀、ドリル、鈴を装備可能です。
en: A plastic model of the BB warriors of the first monster taming warriors in the history of Musha Gunmu, "Enjuuika and Kaijuumaru", who appear in "SD Gundamu Musha○den 3", which is currently being serialized in Comic Bonbon, and are companions of Hakimaru. Contains 2 figures: Tono (Okochama form) and Enjouji. By merging them together, you can recreate the transformation into Kawijumaru warrior form. Can be equipped with a tomahawk, hatchet, sword, drill, and bell.
